fields.text: A reader lives a thousand lives before he dies. The man who never reads lives only one.
fields.author: George R.R. Martin

fields.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
fields.author: Steve Jobs

fields.text: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
fields.author: Nelson Mandela

fields.text: The more that you read, the more things you will know. The more that you learn, the more places you'll go.
fields.author: Dr. Seuss

fields.text: Knowledge is power. Information is liberating.
fields.author: Kofi Annan

fields.text: Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body.
fields.author: Joseph Addison

fields.text: The beautiful thing about learning is that no one can take it away from you.
fields.author: B.B. King

fields.text: Books are a uniquely portable magic.
fields.author: Stephen King

fields.text: There is no friend as loyal as a book.
fields.author: Ernest Hemingway

fields.text: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
fields.author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
